Revenue & Distribution

Hotel Inventory Distribution in India

Hotel inventory distribution assigns sale conditions to each partner and reconciles bookings and availability across channels.

Discuss your project

Design availability by room type

Decide which partners receive free sale, defined allocations or on-request booking. Set safety rules around scarce room categories, group blocks and event dates.

Reconcile every day of a rollout

Check confirmed rooms, remaining inventory and rejected availability updates. Define who takes action when a partner continues to sell after a stop sale.
